type.description: Defines the notification type. - regular: Standard notification appearance. - application: Application-level notification with additional icon. Default is regular.

direction.description: Sets the layout direction of the notification. - horizontal: Content and actions are arranged side-by-side. - vertical: Content and actions are stacked. Default is horizontal.

hasTimestamp.description: If true, displays a timestamp label (e.g., "09:12:46") in the notification. Default is false.

hasDay.description: If true (and hasTimestamp is also true), displays a day label (e.g., "Yesterday") in the notification. Default is false.

action.description: If true, displays a primary action button (e.g., "Close"). Default is false.

action2.description: If true, displays a secondary action button (e.g., "Undo"). Only available if action is also true. Default is false.

lineType.description: Sets the line type for the notification content. - singleLine: Compact, single-line layout. - multiLine: Supports longer, multi-line descriptions. Default is singleLine.

primaryIconName.description: The icon in the `primary-icon` slot, by name (a bundled icon); empty puts none. Custom main icon, projected into the child only when type="application" (the built-in notification icon is used otherwise).

title.description: The text in the `title` slot; empty puts none. Title or heading of the notification.

description.description: The text in the `description` slot; empty puts none. Detailed message text.

time.description: The time of the notification, drawn while `hasTimestamp` is true.

day.description: The day of the notification, drawn while `hasDay` is true.

actionLabel.description: The label of the primary action button, drawn while `action` is true.

action2Label.description: The label of the secondary action button, drawn while `action2` is true.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
